title: Website freezes when changing currency on product page
source_bug_description: When changing the currency to pay the entire website freezes.
detailed_steps: 1. Navigate to the 'Find Bugs' page: https://academybugs.com/find-bugs/ .
2. Identify and click on the first available product link (e.g., a product like 'DNK Yellow Shoes') to navigate to its product detail page.
3. On the product detail page, locate the currency selection dropdown menu.
4. Click the currency selection dropdown to expand it.
5. Select a currency different from the currently displayed one (e.g., if USD is shown, select EUR or GBP).
6. Observe the application. The expected bug behavior is that the website becomes unresponsive or freezes after changing the currency.
expected_bug_behavior: The website interface becomes unresponsive or freezes after attempting to change the currency on a product page.

title: X/Twitter social share link leads to DNS_PROBE_FINISHED_NXDOMAIN
source_bug_description: Clicking the X/Twitter social share button on a product page results in a DNS_PROBE_FINISHED_NXDOMAIN error.
detailed_steps: 1. Open a new Firefox browser window.
2. Navigate to the 'Find Bugs' page: https://academybugs.com/find-bugs/ .
3. Identify and click on the first available product link (e.g., 'DNK Yellow Shoes') to navigate to its product detail page.
4. On the product detail page, locate the social media share icon for 'X' (formerly Twitter).
5. Click the 'X' (Twitter) social share icon.
6. Observe the browser. Note any new tabs opened and error messages displayed.
7. (Optional CUA Instruction - if capable) Attempt to open browser developer tools and check the console and network tabs for specific error details.
expected_bug_behavior: The browser displays a 'This site can't be reached' error page with a DNS_PROBE_FINISHED_NXDOMAIN message, instead of navigating to a Twitter sharing interface.

title: Clicking 'HOT ITEM' on product page leads to perpetual loading
source_bug_description: On a product detail page, clicking the 'HOT ITEM' image/link in the sidebar causes the page/section to load perpetually.
detailed_steps: 1. Open a new Firefox browser window.
2. Navigate to the 'Find Bugs' page: https://academybugs.com/find-bugs/ .
3. Identify and click on any product link (e.g., 'Silver Heart Bracelet') to navigate to its product detail page.
4. On the product detail page, locate the 'HOT ITEM' section, usually displayed in a sidebar with an image of a product.
5. Click on the 'HOT ITEM' image or its associated link.
6. Observe the main content area of the page and the browser's loading indicators.
7. (Optional CUA Instruction - if capable) Attempt to open browser developer tools and check the console and network tabs for continuously pending requests or JavaScript errors.
expected_bug_behavior: The page (or a significant portion of it) enters a perpetual loading state (e.g., a spinner icon remains indefinitely, browser tab shows loading animation) and does not resolve to display new content or return to an idle state.
